job.title: Fixed Plant Mechanical Fitter
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Fixed Plant Mechanical Technician to join a major mining and industrial operation in the Pilbara.

The Role

You will carry out preventative and corrective maintenance, hydraulic repairs and mechanical fault-finding across a range of fixed plant equipment.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Carrying out scheduled preventative and corrective maintenance on fixed plant equipment.

  • Reading and interpreting hydraulic schematics and technical drawings.
  • Completing maintenance records and work orders using a maintenance management system.
  • Working closely with Operations, Electrical and Engineering teams.
  • Maintaining high safety standards and following site procedures, isolations and permit-to-work requirements.

  • Experience with preventative maintenance and breakdown response.
  • Current Australian driver's licence.

Desirable
  • Working at Heights and Confined Space tickets.
  • High Risk Work Licence, forklift or EWP licence.
  • Dogging or rigging experience.
  • Experience with maintenance management systems.
